commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
90+4' Great chance! Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) picks up a rebound inside the box, cuts inside his marker but rifles his shot high over the bar.
90+2' The corner is swung in but Ath Bilbao can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

90+2' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the right post is blocked by Marko Dmitrovic, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
90+1' Ath Bilbao take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) rises above the defence inside the box to power a fine header, but the goalkeeper is lucky as the ball flies just over the bar.

87' Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
86' Clemens Riedel (Espanyol) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mateo Busquets had an easy-decision to make.
86' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
84' That's the end of the game for Exposito, who is replaced by Ruben Sanchez (Espanyol).
83' Substitution. Carlos Romero is replaced by Clemens Riedel (Espanyol).
83' Here is a change. Tyrhys Dolan is going off and Manolo Gonzalez gives the last tactical orders to Jose Salinas (Espanyol).
83' Exposito (Espanyol) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
82' Alejandro Rego (Ath Bilbao) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
80' Alejandro Rego (Ath Bilbao) has tested the patience of referee Mateo Busquets and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
79' The substitution has been made. Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) has replaced Inaki Williams.
79' Alejandro Rego (Ath Bilbao) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his low effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
77' Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) has tested the patience of referee Mateo Busquets and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
76' Ernesto Valverde has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jesus Areso (Ath Bilbao) replacing Andoni Gorosabel.
76' The game has come to an end for Adama Boiro. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao).

74' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
72' Manolo Gonzalez prepares a substitution. Pol Lozano is replaced by Kike Garcia (Espanyol).
70' A dangerous looking corner kick from Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is cleared to safety by the defence.
70' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
69' The attendance for today's match is 47586.
68' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Ath Bilbao comes to nothing.
68' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick.
66' That was close by Jofre (Espanyol)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post.
65' A cross into the box from Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) is cleared.
64' Ath Bilbao couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Marko Dmitrovic (Espanyol) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
62' 60:40 – the ratio of ball possession.
60' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
57' The referee allows time for a substitution. Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta will be replaced by Alejandro Rego (Ath Bilbao).
57' Ernesto Valverde decides to make a substitution. Nico Williams will be replaced by Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao).
57' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jofre (Espanyol) is coming onto the pitch as Pere Milla cannot continue after picking up an injury.
56' Mateo Busquets blows his whistle for a foul after Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) hacks down one of his opponents.
52' 1 - 2 Goal! Pere Milla (Espanyol) takes a short pass from Tyrhys Dolan in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot low into the middle of the goal. 1:2.
50' The Ath Bilbao players are exchanging some short passes.
49' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the bottom right corner, but Marko Dmitrovic is equal to it and makes an easy save.
48' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao).
46' Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+1' Mateo Busquets shows a yellow card to Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) for his blatant foul.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' 1 - 1 Goal! Carlos Romero (Espanyol) shows perfect technique and produces a first-time effort from just outside the box that goes inside the left post. It's 1:1.
44' It will be a corner kick for Espanyol.
42' Good movement by Carlos Romero (Espanyol), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.

40' A neat pass finds Exposito (Espanyol) in space. He needs no second invitation to shoot and hits a piledriver from distance towards the right side of the goal, but Unai Simon denies him with a good save.
38' 1 - 0 Goal! Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:0.

37' That was a nice football moment. Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the right post. Marko Dmitrovic guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
36' The ball is behind the sideline. Carlos Romero (Espanyol) takes a throw-in.
33' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) was quite harsh and Mateo Busquets didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
32' Espanyol take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
32' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
31' Exposito (Espanyol) takes the corner.
31' Pere Milla (Espanyol) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
30' Ath Bilbao fail to score from a corner as Marko Dmitrovic (Espanyol) leaps to collect the ball.
29' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) picks up a pass and has an effort from the edge of the box, but Marko Dmitrovic gets down to his right to keep it out.
28' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mateo Busquets had an easy-decision to make.
26' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.
24' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) takes it short.
23' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

23' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) connects with a cross on the edge of the box, controls the ball and pulls the trigger. Marko Dmitrovic makes a beautiful save to deny his effort which would have ended in the bottom left corner.
21' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) brings his opponent down. Mateo Busquets has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
20' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
18' The ball rebounds to Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) and he shoots from distance, but the keeper calmly watches it drift high over the bar.
17' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends a cross into the box, but Marko Dmitrovic comes off his line to gather the ball.
16' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Mateo Busquets blows his whistle for a foul.
14' Exposito (Espanyol) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
13' Pere Milla (Espanyol) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.

12' Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the middle of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
11' Ath Bilbao control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
10' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
8' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao).
7' Pere Milla (Espanyol) trips an opposition player and Mateo Busquets signals a foul.
5' Wonderful movement by Ath Bilbao. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
3' Espanyol are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
3' The ball goes out of play and Espanyol will have a goal kick.
1' The match has just started.
Espanyol will kick-off.
Mateo Busquets was nominated as the referee for this game.
